LiquidGlass shader adaptation in Stack
=====================================

Upstream: https://github.com/OverShifted/LiquidGlass
Pinned revision: 3797fa541c1f026c521a75885ee271f03bdf9f0f
Copyright (c) 2026 Sepehr Kalanaki
License: MIT; the complete original notice is in LiquidGlass-MIT.txt.

Source scope:
- assets/shaders/BatchRenderer2D.glsl: glass refraction profile, glow and noise.
- assets/shaders/Blur.glsl: separable Gaussian blur.
- src/BlurPass.h: horizontal/vertical blur-pass arrangement.
- src/LiquidGlass.h and src/LiquidGlass.cpp: material and blur settings.

Stack adapts this material for its independent OpenGL renderer and existing
framebuffer/compositor, rather than importing the demo engine. Adaptations
include Stack shader interfaces and bounded scene sampling, a flush-left rail
with only exposed right corners rounded, and rail-specific visual tuning.
The adapted shader source is in src/ThirdParty/LiquidGlass/LiquidGlassShaders.h;
the original Stack wrapper is src/Renderer/GlassChromeShaders.h. Stack retains
the upstream material equations and application defaults while replacing the
full squircle mapping with a cropped, one-sided rail silhouette. The upstream
reversed-edge smoothstep is expressed as 1 - smoothstep with ascending edges
to avoid undefined GLSL behavior.
The upstream OverEngine submodule, demo application, photographs, fonts and
showcase assets are not included by this adaptation.

Embedded blur provenance
------------------------
The blur13 function in the pinned LiquidGlass shaders matches the function in
13.glsl from glsl-fast-gaussian-blur, apart from texture/texture2D spelling and
formatting. The same project also provides blur5 and blur9. The LiquidGlass
files do not identify that origin inline. Stack retains the matching upstream
MIT notice separately rather than assuming the top-level notice replaces it:

Project: https://github.com/Experience-Monks/glsl-fast-gaussian-blur
(formerly Jam3/glsl-fast-gaussian-blur)
Verified revision: 5dbb6e97aa43d4be9369bdd88e835f47023c5e2a
Source: 13.glsl
Copyright (c) 2015 Jam3
License: MIT; see GLSL-Fast-Gaussian-Blur-MIT.txt.

Stack's original code and modifications remain GPL-3.0-only. These retained
MIT notices apply to the upstream portions; they do not relicense the whole
Stack application or imply endorsement by upstream authors or Apple.
